campaigns.name: Direct Assessment — English→Assamese
campaigns.instructions: Rate each translation for Adequacy and Fluency on a 1–5 scale.

criteria.name: Adequacy
criteria.guide: Does the translation convey the full meaning of the source, without adding or losing information?

criteria.name: Fluency
criteria.guide: Is the translation grammatical and natural in the target language?

campaigns.name: System Comparison — English→Manipuri
campaigns.instructions: Compare the two candidate translations (A and B) and choose which better conveys the source meaning in natural language.

campaigns.name: Error Annotation (MQM) — English→Mizo

criteria.name: Mistranslation
criteria.guide: The target says something different from the source.

criteria.name: Omission
criteria.guide: Source content is missing from the target.

criteria.name: Addition
criteria.guide: The target adds content not present in the source.

criteria.name: Grammar
criteria.guide: Grammatical or morphological error in the target.

campaigns.instructions: Mark spans of the translation that contain errors, choosing the error type for each. Tick "reviewed" for every segment, even those with no errors.
campaigns.span_instructions: Select the smallest span that contains the error, then pick its type. Overlapping spans of different types are allowed.

campaigns.name: Summarization quality (English)
campaigns.instructions: Read the document, then rate its summary on each criterion (1–5).

criteria.name: Coherence
criteria.guide: Is the summary well-structured and logically organized?

criteria.name: Consistency
criteria.guide: Are all facts in the summary supported by the document (no hallucinations)?

criteria.name: Fluency
criteria.guide: Is the summary grammatical and well-written?

criteria.name: Relevance
criteria.guide: Does the summary capture the most important information and omit trivia?

campaigns.name: LLM response comparison (English)
campaigns.instructions: Read the user's question, then compare the two assistant responses (A and B) and choose which is the better reply.

campaigns.name: Post-editing — English→Assamese
campaigns.instructions: Read the source, then edit the translation to correct any errors. If it is already correct, leave it unchanged.
